title: Izharul Hauque v. State of U.P.
coram: Dr. D.Y. Chandrachud, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Notice issued on the challenge to the vires of clause 4.3(f)(v); interim order restraining enforcement of the recovery citation against the petitioner-Director, without restraining recovery against the company; matter listed for hearing.
headnote: In a challenge to the vires of clause 4.3(f)(v) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 — which requires that recovery of a defaulting company-consumer's electricity dues be ensured from its Directors — the Court held that the issue required consideration, issued notice to the Advocate General, and by interim order restrained enforcement of the recovery citation against the petitioner-Director while leaving recovery against the company (the seventh respondent) unaffected. The order is interlocutory; the vires question was not decided.
facts: A recovery citation dated 1 January 2016 was issued by the Tehsildar, Khatauli (District Muzaffarnagar) for Rs.2,12,40,204 in electricity dues against both the seventh respondent — a private limited company that was the consumer under the supply agreement — and the petitioner, Izharul Hauque, a Director of that company. The petitioner challenged clause 4.3(f)(v) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, under which recovery from the Directors of a company-consumer must be ensured, as ultra vires the Electricity Act, 2003, contending that the definition of 'consumer' in s.2(15) does not permit recovery against Directors.

holding_units.topic: Director liability for a company-consumer's dues — vires challenge (interim)
holding_units.question: Whether recovery of a defaulting company-consumer's electricity dues can be enforced against its Director under clause 4.3(f)(v), or whether that clause is ultra vires s.2(15) of the Electricity Act, 2003.
holding_units.holding: Interlocutory. The challenge to the vires of clause 4.3(f)(v) requires consideration; notice was issued to the Advocate General, and by way of interim protection the recovery citation shall not be enforced against the petitioner-Director, without restraining recovery of the dues against the company (the seventh respondent) in accordance with law.
holding_units.flag: Interlocutory order; the vires question is not decided. A later order dated 24 February 2023 is a listing order, indicating the matter remained pending.

not_decided.point: Vires of clause 4.3(f)(v) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 — whether recovery of a company-consumer's electricity dues may be enforced against its Director, or whether the clause is ultra vires s.2(15) of the Electricity Act, 2003
not_decided.note: Admitted for consideration; notice issued to the Advocate General; interim protection granted to the Director. Not decided in this order.
